units.source_text: 今年正月十四日举行男踏歌会。

en.t: On the fourteenth day of the first month this year, the men's toka singing and dancing festival was held.

units.source_text: 歌舞行列先赴朱雀院，然后来到六条院。

en.t: The procession of singers and dancers first went to Suzaku-in, and then came to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 因路远，到达时已近黎明。

en.t: Because the way was long, it was already nearly dawn when they arrived.

units.source_text: 皓月当空，明澄如水；庭中薄雾弥漫，景色美不可言。

en.t: A bright moon hung in the sky, clear and luminous as water; a light mist filled the garden, and the scene was beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 此时殿上人中擅长音乐者甚多，笛声非常优美。

en.t: At this time many of the courtiers were skilled in music, and the sound of the flutes was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 到了这六条院，音乐奏得更加起劲。

en.t: Once they reached Rokujo-in, the music was played with even greater spirit.

units.source_text: 源氏要教诸女眷都出来看歌舞，预先通知她们。

en.t: Genji wanted all the ladies of the household to come out and watch the singing and dancing, so he had informed them in advance.

units.source_text: 所以正殿两旁的厢屋及廊房里，都设置座位，让她们坐在这里观看。

en.t: Therefore seats were arranged in the side chambers and corridors on both sides of the main hall, so that the women could sit there and watch.

units.source_text: 住在西厅的玉鬘，来到南面紫姬所居的正殿内，与明石小女公子初次见面。

en.t: Tamakazura, who lived in the western wing, came to the main hall on the south side where Lady Murasaki resided, and met the young Akashi princess for the first time.

units.source_text: 紫姬也出来了，只隔一层帷屏，与玉鬘谈话。

en.t: Lady Murasaki also came out, and spoke with Tamakazura with only a single curtain-screen between them.

units.source_text: 歌舞行列是从朱雀院的母后那边绕道而来的，到此已近天明。

en.t: The procession of singers and dancers had come by way of the residence of Suzaku-in's mother, and by the time it arrived here, daybreak was already near.

units.source_text: 本来只须款待茶酒和羹汤，然而此次犒赏格外丰盛，大办筵席，殷勤招待。

en.t: Ordinarily it would have been enough to offer tea, wine, and soup, but this time the rewards were especially generous, with a grand banquet laid out and the guests received most attentively.
